_comment: ClawDeck's additions to assets/games.json (tools/gen_games.py merges them). re_engine_exes: Capcom RE Engine games, which need REFramework (dinput8.dll) next to OptiScaler or Capcom's anti-tamper stops the game (seen with Onimusha on the Claw 8 EX, 2026-11-04). games: by id, wins over OptiScaler's entry.

capcom._comment: Every game in re_engine_exes gets OptiClick's Capcom setup (onehoon's REFramework, OptiScaler v10 in the OptiScaler/ subfolder, DLSS-G to XeSS-FG; launchenv.capcom). tested: seen working on a Claw, with where and when. untested: games known to have DLSS frame generation the setup relies on, not run on a Claw yet; the rest of re_engine_exes is untested too.

tested.onimushawots.exe: Onimusha: Way of the Sword, Claw 8 EX on Bazzite, 2026-11-04
